rationale.conceptual: The method relies on the Saha ionization model with first and second ionization of argon, partition functions, and derived formulas for refractive index and its temperature derivative. Translating these into correct numerical code requires understanding of plasma thermodynamics and careful implementation of cubic root solving and differentiation, which is an established but non-trivial method.
rationale.execution: The pipeline consists of a few straightforward steps: solve Saha equations for one temperature range, compute refractive properties for two wavelengths, and extract intervals. Uses only NumPy/SciPy, no data fetching, no complex tooling. Straightforward I/O with CSV outputs.
